name: tactical-arena-mobile
description: Capacitor Android/iOS shell for Tactical Arena. Packages the live web game; never edits it. NOTE: measure APK size with `npm run apk:clean` — incremental assembleDebug reuses the old zip layout and leaves gaps, which inflated a 54MB APK to 143MB.

scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:clean: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat clean assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat clean assembleRelease
scripts.bundle:release: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat clean bundleRelease
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && cap run android
